thread.text:
Today: Squat ran heavier than scripted — 80kg × 5, 5, 5 against the prescribed 70kg for 8–10 — repeating the exact loads from 09-27. The anchor slot swapped: Romanian Deadlift at 80kg × 5, 7, 5 instead of the scripted Deadlift 3×5 @ 60kg. Leg Press was replaced again by Leg Extension (10kg × 10, 10, 10), as it was last time out. Kneeling Leg Curl came in at 10kg × 8, 8, 8, heavier than the prescribed 7.5kg for 10–12. Calf raise and hanging leg raise both landed close to target: 40kg × 10, 10, 10 and bodyweight × 10, 10, 10.

Trend: Squat has now logged identical numbers two sessions running (09-27 and today), which doesn't meet the +2.5kg rule (10 reps across all sets) either way it's read. Kneeling Leg Curl at 10kg has given sets of 8 across three sessions now (09-12, 09-27, 10-02) without clearing the 10–12 band — that's a three-session stall worth a look rather than more weight. Leg Press hasn't been touched in a month; Leg Extension has filled that slot twice straight, which looks like a de facto swap rather than a one-off.

Right lat: 0/10 today, continuing the drop from Thursday's 6/10 spike. No pulling or rowing in this session to stress-test it further, so today's reading only confirms rest-state comfort, not load tolerance.

Next session: Upper C, Saturday. Open the row with the 14kg check set — 3 or under on the right earns 18kg for the rest, 4 or more means staying at 14kg or skipping it. Lateral raise is close to the 20-hold target (16, 16, 16 on 09-28); push for 20 across all three sets.

Question: the deadlift anchor became an RDL today despite 0/10 pain — was that a planned swap, or did the lat talk during warm-up?
